markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (62%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set [F1], yet 36% invasive risk, 4/5 Invasive neighbors, and positive margins.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 62%, Invasive 36%, Benign 1%, Normal 1% | Favors InSitu; 36% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (alpha 10%, coverage 90%, CI 76%–98%) | Single-class 90% set |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th percentile OOD [F6] | Extreme OOD; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models share top class |
| Similar cases | 1/5 (20%) InSitu, 4/5 (80%) Invasive [F5] | Nearest neighbors favor Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.48, +0.88), 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.41, +0.62), 20/20 spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.38), 19/20 spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Descriptive (+0.31), 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated (+0.21), 3/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion beats random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088–0.0064); uses Unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section artifact (severity 3, 100th percentile OOD) masks invasion; 4/5 neighbors are Invasive (BACH_0379, 73%).
- High-risk regions (9, 7, 10, 1, 5; risk 97%–100%) harbor invasion within 5% calibration error.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 9, 10, 1, 5**: Highest risk (97%–100%); exclude stromal invasion versus duct-confined tumor.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11**: Check inferior/lateral margins (108 um each) [F7]; frozen stains blocked.

found: Bottom line verdict should be 'Confident' because the conformal set is {InSitu}.
The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
